user.title: Add an Open Farm Link Head Device
user.description: Head Devices on this network are normally discovered automatically. Enter an address only if yours wasn't.

data.insecure: Bench mode: plain HTTP, no pairing (firmware without security)

insecure_confirm.title: Add {name} without security?
insecure_confirm.description:
Found Garden **{name}** (`{garden_id}`, OFL {protocol_version}) at {host}.

Its firmware doesn't support the protocol's security: no encryption, no pairing, no login. **Anyone on your network can read it and switch its valves and lights**, and Home Assistant can't tell whether it is talking to the real device.

Use this only for a test rig on a network you trust. Add it anyway?

pair.title: Pair with Garden {garden_id}
pair.description: Found a Head Device at {host}. Choose how to prove you own it:

menu_options.pair_setup_code: Setup code (from the device or its packaging)

pair_button.title: Press the pairing button
pair_button.description:
Briefly press the pairing button on the Head Device (on a dev board: BOOT). It stays open for 2 minutes. Then submit.

Anyone on your network can pair while that window is open — you'll see the full list of credentials on the next screen.

pair_setup_code.title: Enter the setup code
pair_setup_code.description: 16 characters, e.g. 7K2M-Q9XD-4HTR-8WCN. Works only for a device nobody has paired with yet. Home Assistant first checks that the device really knows this code before sending it.

pair_credentials.title: Use an existing login
pair_credentials.description: A username/password created earlier, e.g. from the official app or with curl.

paired.title: Paired with Garden {garden_id}

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Head Device. It accepts only one connection at a time — close other apps talking to it and retry.
error.identity_mismatch: The device's identity doesn't check out (different key than expected, or it doesn't know this setup code). Not pairing.
error.pairing_closed: The device isn't accepting pairing right now. Press its pairing button (or, for an unpaired device, use its setup code).
error.setup_code_mismatch: This setup code doesn't match this device — check for a typo. (The code was not sent: Home Assistant checks it against the device first.)
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts — the device only accepts one try every 10 seconds now.
error.no_free_slots: The device's credential storage is full. Revoke an unused credential first.
error.username_taken: That username is already used on this device.

abort.already_configured: This Garden is already set up.
abort.not_ofl_device: Not an Open Farm Link Head Device.
abort.device_reset: This Head Device has a new identity — it was factory reset, which makes it a new Garden. Remove this entry and add the device again.
abort.insecure_no_auth: Bench-mode devices have no credentials to re-pair. Remove the entry and add the device again.

dry_raw.description: Raw reading with the dry pot in air.
